subject: general
question:
Out of the letter-clusters given below, four are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the odd one.

AF EJ IN MR QU
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8917e7e4a037fb946fafa0b16de664d6f0ce32ab76e5c2c9b848dc1f771a7f81.png] 

The logic followed here is: **1st letter + 5 = 2nd letter**

AF ⇒ A + 5 = F(6)

EJ ⇒ E + 5 = J(10)

IN ⇒ I + 5 = N(14)

MR ⇒ M + 5 = R(18)

**QU ⇒ Q + 4 = Q(17)**

Thus,** QU i**s odd one.

Hence, the correct answer is "QU".
